author: StarTalk
description:
What is light? Neil deGrasse Tyson and Chuck Nice break down perhaps the most important explainer. Learn how electricity and magnetism joined forces (or fields) to become the electromagnetic spectrum we know today. 

Timestamps: 
00:00 - Introduction: Electromagnetic Spectrum
00:14 - Joining Electricity & Magnetism
05:07 - What Determines an Object’s Color? 
08:52 - Wavelengths & Frequency: Light Not Fit for Vision
14:36 - Why The Microwave is Safe
17:58 - Seeing Things With Different Wavelengths of Light
